title: Berlinale Talents
subtitle: Berlin
content:
Two hundred invited filmmakers took part in a mix of discussions, workshops, labs, and tanks, alongside a series of public talks that with director Chloé Zhao and composer Daniel Blumberg, Sentimental Value collaborators Eskil Vogt and Olivier Bugge Coutté, actor Hiam Abbass and many others.

[•](https://www.deutscher-kurzfilmpreis.de/Webs/DKFP/startseite/startseite_node.html) [Daniel Huss at Berlinale Talents ](https://www.berlinale-talents.de/bt/talent/daniel-huss/profile)
